content: This is interesting, as I had never investigated this. When entering email address on the TO line, Thunderbird does a simple search, character by characters as the letters are entered. For example, had you entered 'office' the default would have been listed first. The only place to my knowledge where the default setting is effective is if you set the addressbook to list on left side of compose screen ( done by pressing F9). Then, if you use the addressbook list and click an entry, the default appears on the TO line. Since the search for the TO line is character by character, identifying by default is not possible. My suggestion is to use the F9 list when wanting to send by default, and use the addressbook, locating name and then selecting the desired alternate email address.
